description: This file is a shell script used for managing a web server setup for Git web interface via instaweb. It contains functions for starting, stopping, and configuring various HTTP servers such as lighttpd, apache2, WEBrick, mongoose, plackup, and Python-based servers, specifically tuned for GitWeb. It also includes configuration templates for these servers and mechanisms for launching and browsing the web interface.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolves the full path and command for the specified httpd server based on its name, ensuring correct execution.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the web server based on the configured parameters, including generating configuration files and launching the server process.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the running web server by killing its process using stored PID.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Waits until the specified http server is accessible on the configured port.

methods.name: webrick_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration files and server script for WEBrick server.

methods.name: apache2_conf
methods.description: Creates configuration files for Apache2 or httpd server.

methods.name: plackup_conf
methods.description: Creates a PSGI script for running gitweb with Plack.

methods.name: python_conf
methods.description: Generates a configuration and wrapper script for Python's HTTP server with CGI support.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Selects and executes the appropriate server configuration generator based on specified httpd.
